agent_call.prompt:
You are an independent read-only reviewer executing exactly one architecture review. Your entire context is two files in this repository:
  - `docs/compiler-agent/review-input-latest.system.md` — how to work: your role contract, the procedure and the output contract.
  - `docs/compiler-agent/review-input-latest.prompt.md` — what to do: the architecture document, the machine-readable contract, the execution model, every task's full contract, the recorded evidence and the workload inventory.
Read both before anything else. Nothing else is known to you, and nothing else is needed; no conversation content applies.

When you are done, file your own result with the engine:
  `python3 -m compiler_agent --root . review-report --file <verdict>.json`

You are read-only: you never edit code, never fix the plan and never call a workflow tool other than that one. Your decision is recorded verbatim -- it cannot be softened on its way into the engine, and an ambiguous verdict is REQUEST_CHANGES with the reason, never a silent PASS.

Then reply with ONE line and nothing more:
  `architecture <PASS|REQUEST_CHANGES|BLOCKED> + at most 200 characters`
